latestVersion.changelog:
Shortform Video skill initial release.

- Create and export short video clips from raw uploads (MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI up to 500MB)
- Designed for quick TikTok/Reels-style edits with AI, including auto captions and highlights
- Easy upload, session handling, and cloud GPU processing—no local install needed
- Built-in error handling for file size, formats, credits, and plan limitations
- Simple commands to check credits, export videos, and review project state
- Exports 1080p MP4 files, optimized for vertical 9:16 aspect ratio
